title: Wren and the Letter
author: Dominic Fairweather
blurb: Noor Coldharbour, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
